name: When should I consider a kitchen lighting upgrade?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a kitchen lighting upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider a kitchen lighting upgrade if your current lighting is insufficient for cooking tasks, creates shadows, or makes your kitchen feel dim and uninviting. Upgrading is also beneficial if you're renovating your kitchen, want to improve energy efficiency, or desire a more modern aesthetic. Outdated fixtures, high electricity bills from inefficient bulbs, or a lack of proper illumination for daily activities are all strong indicators that it's time for an upgrade. A well-designed lighting scheme can dramatically transform the functionality and mood of your kitchen.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider a kitchen lighting upgrade if current lighting is insufficient, outdated, inefficient, or if you're renovating to improve functionality and aesthetics.
